subject: Re: meeting tomorrow
text: Thanks again for the note. I can meet at two. Your work desk is loud. I suggested the staff room. It is much quieter. Bring your printed forms. We can check page one. Page two confused me. I marked the evening slots. That should help you. If your shift moves, text me. I will wait by the window. Please bring the pen set. We can sign after the review. Your reminder saved time. I’m a student worker. I booked the room. It has good light. Please wear comfortable shoes. We may stand a while. Bring water too. I will explain the forms slowly.
